name: geppetto
description: Policy-based, explainable model routing for Claude Code subagents. Opt-in; fails open to native behavior.

mode.title: Routing mode
mode.description: off: do nothing. observe: record what Geppetto would decide, change nothing. route: set the model (and narrow to a read-only agent) on subagent spawns that made no explicit choice.

modelParam.title: How the chosen model is passed
modelParam.description: alias: haiku/sonnet/opus/fable, resolved by Claude Code to its current version. id: the policy's full model id.

classifier.title: Haiku classifier for ambiguous tasks
classifier.description: Ask a low-effort Haiku call to classify tasks the deterministic rules cannot, when its expected value beats its cost. Off by default.

enforceBudget.title: Enforce subagent tool-call budgets
enforceBudget.description: Refuse a routed subagent's tool calls past its maxTurns budget so it reports back. Off by default (budgets are advisory).

policyPath.title: Policy file
policyPath.description: Project-relative JSON file merged over the default policy.
